editor.notes: The studio's plugin data editor (D-10 section 4, plugin API 3): the Plugin data panel (a tab of the Studio's World page and the map editor while the game has a plugin with a connector: the inspector built from the connector's schemas, the records of each attach point, previews, import and export), the connectors' checks as a validator, and the ext command group. A built-in extension, loaded through the same plugin host as project plugins (capsule_studio.plugins).
